image_description: A group of people, including children and adults, are dancing around a tall wooden maypole in an urban park setting. The pole is topped with a decorative crown-like structure from which numerous long, colorful ribbons (streamers) extend downwards. Dancers are holding the ends of these streamers, weaving them around the pole. The background features city buildings and trees.
